{"code": "sales_df_clean = sales_df_clean.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Compute conversion rate by channel, stratified by customer_segment
conversion_by_channel_segment = sales_df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()
print(f'Conversion rate by channel and customer_segment:\n{conversion_by_channel_segment}')

# Compute average revenue by channel and customer_segment
avg_revenue_by_channel_segment = sales_df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].mean().reset_index()
print(f'Average revenue by channel and customer_segment:\n{avg_revenue_by_channel_segment}')"}
